sources.title: Ransomware Recovery Scam Nets $11M as AI Hits Banks
sources.snippet: A ransomware-recovery CEO accused of secretly paying hackers while billing victims an $11 million markup. Rogue AI agents hammering Wikimedia’s servers with millions of automated requests. A suspected China-based hacker using an open-source AI pentesting tool and Anthropic’s Claude Code to attack South Korean financial institutions, with 16 firms affected by October 14. Three stories broke ...
